Projected Fantasy Defense Season Stats With ADP

params.name: format
params.description: Desired response format. Valid entries are JSON or XML.

params.description:

info.name: DFS Slate Ownership Projections - by Slate

params.name: format
params.description: Desired response format. Valid entries are JSON or XML.

params.name: slateId
params.description: SlateID of the DFS Slate you wish to get ownership projections for. Will have an empty SlateOwnershipProjections if this slate was not projected

items.docs: Slate Ownership Projections for a specific slate. Projections are for Guaranteed Prize Pool (GPP) format ownership. Will return an empty list if the slate is not yet projected or not a slate we have projections for.
